rubrics.rubric: Is the total Q3 net commission across all reps 16650.39?
criterion: Sum of net_commission over all rows is 16650.39 (within 0.05 for rounding)

rubrics.rubric: Does output/commissions.csv contain the correct gross, clawback and net per rep and month?
criterion: Columns rep_id,month,gross_commission,clawback,net_commission sorted by rep then month

rubrics.rubric: Are the policy edge cases applied?
criterion: Marginal tiers: a deal crossing the monthly threshold is split between the two rates
R3 is paid on the Junior plan before 2026-08-11 and on the Senior plan from 2026-08-11
Junior upper tier is 8% for deals closed on or after 2026-08-15 (memo), 7% before
Split deals credit split_pct to the split rep and the remainder to the owner
